text: R-D1 (theming): make it a frozen ruling that WLO's base theme is dark-first with a FIXED semantic palette (no alarm-red token exists; held=amber), and Material You dynamic color is opt-in and surfaces-only — semantic and data-viz colors are never wallpaper-sourced. Rationale: reserved semantics + data-viz legibility (design/research/synthesis.md §2.2, C1).
suggestions: Defer to implementation phase, keep as design-doc policy only
Prefer full dynamic color including accents

text: R-D2 (navigation): freeze the five-tab bottom nav — Hub · Plan · Insights · Archive · Digestion — with F02 capture as a flow-over-context (never a tab), F06 reached from the Hub's numbers, F01/F12/F13 under Settings, and Archive/Digestion visible rather than hidden in a 'More' sheet (rationale: IA.md §1; hiding discretion-gated flagship features reads as shame, which R-U7 exists to prevent).
suggestions: Prefer 4 tabs + More sheet for Archive/Digestion
Prefer hub-centric stack with no tabs

text: R-D3 (typography): Inter (OFL-1.1, GPLv3-compatible) as the single UI family — tabular figures mandatory wherever numbers change or align, display optical size for hero numerals, no second typeface. Verified against R-S1 (FSF license list).
suggestions: System font only (Roboto), no bundled font

text: R-D4 (charting): Vico (Apache-2.0) for standard line/bar charts; custom Compose Canvas for the four signature objects (forecast cone, progress ribbon, rings, odometer numerals); one shared month-heatmap implementation reused by F05/F09/F11; YCharts rejected as dormant.
suggestions: Defer library choice to implementation benchmarking

text: R-D5 (delta colors): resolve the tension between F06's user-selectable gain/loss palette (Happy Scale clause) and the no-alarm-red design bar — WLO defaults to a neutral CVD-safe delta pair (down=teal accent, up=neutral grey), users may pick accents from a curated Okabe-Ito-derived set, and red is never a WLO default and never used by WLO's own urgency/anomaly rendering (urgency = position + copy, never hue).
suggestions: Keep classic free red/green as the default pair (user can change)
No user selection; WLO palette fixed for everyone

text: R-D6 (haptics): 'kind haptics' rule — every data-outcome haptic is Confirm-class (short, light) regardless of whether the news is good; Reject-weight haptics are reserved for true blocking errors (invalid BYOK key, corrupt import, the F01 calorie-floor wall) and never for data results; haptics stay the feedback channel when reduced-motion is on.
suggestions: Allow Reject-class haptics on negative data outcomes too

text: Badge visual direction (FEATURES §6 open item 7, F11 badge gallery): the flows and design system assume a direction — minimal geometric marks with the number foregrounded (numbers-first), no illustrations, no mascots.
suggestions: Defer — explore both in a dedicated v1.x design spike

text: F09 pain input granularity (flagged AMBIGUOUS in F09 §4): 4-step chips (none / mild / moderate / severe) vs a 0–10 slider. The two-tap entry ethos favors chips; the correlation moat favors the slider's granularity.
suggestions: 4-step chips, expandable to 0–10 in entry detail (recommended)

text: F08 'Archive' icon (F08 spec flags the icon as needing a discretion review): proposal is an abstract stacked-layers/outline glyph that reads as 'records', deliberately not a camera or body glyph, so it stays neutral in any context.
